title: Learn Web Server & Web Hosting
description: Master web server setup, domain management, and secure hosting from scratch.
headline: Master Web Servers & Hosting from Scratch
intro: From Apache to Nginx, cPanel to cloud — learn to deploy, configure, and secure any website on any hosting platform. Built for real-world skills, not just theory.

outcomes.title: How Web Servers Work
outcomes.text: Understand client-server architecture, HTTP/HTTPS requests, how browsers talk to servers, and what happens behind every URL you type.

outcomes.title: Apache & Nginx Setup
outcomes.text: Install, configure, and manage the two most popular web servers in the world. Set up virtual hosts, handle rewrites, and optimise performance.

outcomes.title: SSL/TLS & HTTPS
outcomes.text: Secure your website with free SSL certificates using Let's Encrypt. Force HTTPS redirects, configure TLS versions, and understand certificate chains.

outcomes.title: cPanel & Shared Hosting
outcomes.text: Master cPanel from top to bottom — File Manager, Email setup, phpMyAdmin, backups, subdomains, FTP, and one-click WordPress installs.

outcomes.title: Cloud Hosting & VPS
outcomes.text: Deploy on AWS, DigitalOcean, or Hostinger VPS. Set up a Linux server from scratch, configure firewall rules, SSH keys, and auto deployments.

outcomes.title: Domain & DNS Management
outcomes.text: Buy and configure domains, point DNS to your server, set up A, CNAME, MX records, manage subdomains, and understand TTL and propagation.

modules.label: Week 4
modules.title: Domain, DNS & SSL Setup
topics: Install free SSL with Let's Encrypt + Certbot

title: Learn Sophos Firewall
description: Configure, harden, and manage enterprise Sophos XG firewalls end-to-end.
headline: Master Sophos Firewall & Network Security
intro: From initial setup to advanced threat protection — learn to configure, manage, and secure enterprise networks using Sophos XG/XGS Firewall. Real labs, real scenarios, zero shortcuts.

outcomes.title: Firewall Fundamentals
outcomes.text: Understand how Sophos XG/XGS Firewall works, the dashboard layout, licensing, initial setup wizard, network zones, and interface configuration.

outcomes.title: Firewall Rules & Policies
outcomes.text: Create, manage, and troubleshoot firewall rules. Understand rule ordering, NAT policies, traffic shaping, and application-based policies.

outcomes.title: IPS & Threat Protection
outcomes.text: Configure Intrusion Prevention System, enable Advanced Threat Protection, set up sandboxing, and respond to real-time security events.

outcomes.title: Web Filtering & Application Control
outcomes.text: Set up URL filtering, HTTPS inspection, web categories, application signatures, and control social media and streaming at the network level.

outcomes.title: VPN Configuration
outcomes.text: Configure Site-to-Site IPsec VPN, SSL VPN for remote access, Sophos Connect client setup, and troubleshoot VPN tunnels end-to-end.

outcomes.title: Monitoring, Logs & Reports
outcomes.text: Analyse firewall logs, set up alerts, read security dashboards, configure Sophos Central cloud management, and generate compliance reports.

title: Learn Active Directory
description: Deploy, secure and administer Windows Active Directory environments.
headline: Learn Active Directory & Identity Management
intro: From domain setup to enterprise-level Group Policy — learn to deploy, configure, and manage Microsoft Active Directory like a real IT administrator. Hands-on labs, real environments, zero shortcuts.

outcomes.title: Active Directory Fundamentals
outcomes.text: Understand what Active Directory is, how domains, forests, and trees work, the role of Domain Controllers, and how AD fits into enterprise IT infrastructure.

outcomes.title: Users, Groups & OUs
outcomes.text: Create and manage user accounts, security and distribution groups, Organisational Units, and apply delegation of control for scalable administration.

outcomes.title: Group Policy (GPO)
outcomes.text: Create, link, and enforce Group Policy Objects to control desktop settings, software deployment, security baselines, and login scripts across the domain.

outcomes.title: DNS, DHCP & AD Integration
outcomes.text: Configure DNS zones and records for Active Directory, set up DHCP scopes, understand SRV records, and troubleshoot name resolution in domain environments.

outcomes.title: AD Security & Authentication
outcomes.text: Master Kerberos and NTLM authentication, fine-grained password policies, account lockout, audit policies, and protect against common AD attacks.

outcomes.title: Azure AD & Hybrid Identity
outcomes.text: Extend on-premises AD to Microsoft Azure, configure Azure AD Connect, set up Single Sign-On, Multi-Factor Authentication, and manage hybrid identities.

title: Build Your First AI Agent

intro: No code. No barriers. Automate real workflows, connect AI models to live data, and deploy intelligent agents that work for you 24/7 — built entirely inside N8n.

outcomes.title: What is an AI Agent?
outcomes.text: Understand how AI agents think, plan, and act autonomously. Learn the difference between a simple automation and a true AI agent that makes decisions.

outcomes.title: N8n from the Ground Up
outcomes.text: Master N8n's visual workflow builder. Learn nodes, triggers, conditions, loops, and error handling — everything you need to automate anything.

outcomes.title: Connect AI to Real Data
outcomes.text: Plug OpenAI, Gemini, or Mistral into your workflows. Let your AI agent read emails, search the web, query databases, and respond intelligently.

outcomes.title: APIs & Webhooks

outcomes.title: Build 10+ Real Agents
outcomes.text: Build a customer support bot, lead qualifier, email responder, social media poster, data summariser, invoice reader, and more — all fully functional.

outcomes.title: Deploy & Self-Host N8n
outcomes.text: Deploy your AI agents 24/7 on the cloud using N8n Cloud or self-host on a VPS. Set up credentials, environment variables, and production-ready workflows.

title: Ethical Hacking: Password Cracking
description: Hands-on password auditing with Hashcat, John the Ripper and real wordlists.
headline: Ethical Hacking: Password Cracking Masterclass
intro: From hash theory to GPU-powered cracking — learn how attackers break passwords and how defenders stop them. Real tools, real wordlists, and real lab scenarios built for aspiring penetration testers.

outcomes.title: Password & Hashing Theory
outcomes.text: Understand how passwords are stored, what hashing algorithms do, the difference between encryption and hashing, and why salting matters for security.

outcomes.title: Dictionary & Wordlist Attacks
outcomes.text: Build and customise wordlists with Crunch and CeWL, use RockYou and custom dictionaries, and run dictionary attacks with Hashcat and John the Ripper.

outcomes.title: Brute Force & Mask Attacks
outcomes.text: Execute brute force attacks with custom character sets, use Hashcat mask attacks to target specific password patterns, and leverage GPU acceleration for speed.

outcomes.title: Rainbow Tables & Hash Lookup
outcomes.text: Understand and use precomputed rainbow tables, perform hash lookup attacks, and learn why modern salting techniques render rainbow tables ineffective.

outcomes.title: Online & Network Password Attacks
outcomes.text: Perform credential stuffing, online brute force with Hydra against SSH, FTP, RDP, and HTTP logins, and understand account lockout bypass techniques.

outcomes.title: Password Defence & Hardening
outcomes.text: Implement strong password policies, enable MFA, configure account lockout, audit password strength, and prevent credential dumping in real environments.

title: Social Media & Android Hacking
description: Explore social engineering, Android security testing, and mobile threat analysis.
headline: Social Media & Android Hacking Masterclass
intro: Learn how attackers compromise social media accounts and Android devices — then learn to defend them. Real techniques, real lab environments, real-world protection skills.

outcomes.title: Phishing & Account Takeover
outcomes.text: Build and analyse phishing pages that clone Instagram, Facebook, and Gmail. Understand how credential harvesting works and how to detect & block it.

outcomes.title: OSINT — Open Source Intelligence
outcomes.text: Find publicly available information about any target — emails, phone numbers, location, linked accounts — using tools like Maltego, Sherlock, and theHarvester.

outcomes.title: Social Engineering Attacks
outcomes.text: Study the psychology behind manipulation attacks — pretexting, baiting, vishing, smishing. Learn how attackers trick users into giving up credentials without any hacking.

outcomes.title: Android Architecture & Security
outcomes.text: Understand Android's security model, permissions system, app sandboxing, APK structure, and how malicious apps bypass device security controls.

outcomes.title: Android Exploitation with Metasploit
outcomes.text: Generate Android payloads, embed them into APKs, and establish Meterpreter sessions — all in a legal, isolated lab. Understand exactly how RATs and spyware operate.

outcomes.title: Defence, Detection & Hardening
outcomes.text: Enable and enforce 2FA, use passkeys, spot phishing attempts, harden Android devices, audit app permissions, and set up alerts for account compromise.
